init.title: Vision provider
init.description:
Pick how room photos are analyzed. `simulated` never leaves this device, `ai_task` uses Home Assistant's own AI task integration (local-first), `grok` sends photos to a cloud service and always asks for consent first.

Local tier status: {ai_task_status}

data.vision_api_key: Cloud API key (grok only — stored on this server)
data.vision_ai_task_ack: I understand where ai_task sends my room photos

data_description.vision_ai_task_ack: Required for the ai_task tier: room photos are sent to the AI task provider configured in your Home Assistant ({ai_task_entity}), which may be a cloud provider. Leave unchecked to be asked before each analysis instead. If you change your AI task entity later, you'll be asked again.
